verdict.rationale: Ollama's core value proposition is fully local inference: docs explicitly state prompts are never tracked/trained on and 'nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine,' and community evidence corroborates that users run models entirely on-device (M4 Pro benchmarks, AMD GPU usage, embedding in local products). This is well-documented as the primary use case, with cloud features being explicitly optional add-ons. missing for 10: independent security audit or technical verification of zero network calls during local inference, and some community friction over configuration/lock-in slightly tempers unqualified trust.
